Most of the mask pieces I can still get to, but I'll have to figure out some way to that blasted island. Hopefully no one has found where I stashed all the parts of the mask. I'll start out to find the pieces nearby right after I feed Chompy. Gotta make sure not to slip again—last time was too close of a call. He's a good boy, but he'd still eat me given the chance! Anyway, I better write this down so I don't forget.  
  
One piece is stashed in an old sunken chest in the Mists. The Mists! That's right, not even the Mists can hold me!  
  
Another one is on that island in Bloodtide Coast. Those gulls better not have been laughing at *me* though, otherwise when I go back I'll be leaving with a nice new feather cloak. Ha-ha!  
  
One piece I'll have to steal back from that DOG Wiley. Upstart thinks that *he's* a treasure hunter? Ha! I'll show him a real pirate soon.  
  
I hid another piece near the wrecks of all those poor, poor SUCKERS who just couldn't cut it as pirates and had to live a sad life of privateering. Those karka sure are quick, but not quick enough to get me!  
  
Another piece I left near the souls of long-dead sailors in Orr. I wonder what it feels like to be a ghost...  
  
And finally, before I set off, I threw a piece off the top of the lighthouse here in Lion's Arch. For good luck! Not that I ever needed luck! What kind of captain would I be if I did?  
  
The other three pieces should be safe and secure on the island waiting for me. I doubt anyone will get past all those traps or find that grotto where I left them.  
  
And the final piece, well, I doubt anyone has figured out how to uncover those chests. And if they have? I'LL KILL THEM! HA!

strings.en:
- First and foremost, never look a journeykin directly in the eye. Not until you've bonded. Doing so too early will provoke the creature. Until a bond has been established, keep your eyes on the creature's chin while slowly blinking.  
  
- Journeykin are not known to attack on sight unless provoked. Patience and exposure is key, as it may take weeks for the journeykin to acclimate if it hasn't been exposed to the bearkin before.  
  
- If the wild journeykin is protecting kits, move away immediately. New mothers will not take kindly to any intrusion. Inform a journeykin trainer immediately if wild kits are found.  
  
- The quickest way to a journeykin's heart is the stomach. Bring dried meat for every encounter.  
  
- Just as bonded journeykin do, wild journeykin respond well to being spoken to. Keep your voice low, soft, and calm during your initial interactions.  
  
- Wild journeykin tend to travel and hunt on their own, but they will linger in areas where they know others are present. If one is in distress, the others may come. Similarly, if a journeykin had bonded with a bearkin, others familiar with its smell may be easier to bond with.
